decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and only mentioned rather than featured, but it is a niche maritime line with long defence procurement cycles, and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it while results remain uncertain.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on certified manufacturing and test facilities, had their own page and received a follow-up LED retrofit kit, which signals performance at or above aspiration.

The relaunched designer task light is close to the core and kept its own page, but it is a single model in a competitive design segment, so a shortfall could prompt problemistic search for other uses of its resources.
The pendant office luminaire fits the core office lighting business and LED efficiency strategy, and it is too recent to judge against aspiration, so the firm keeps it.
The premium pendant line with several models signals commitment, sits close to the established offer and supports the firm's expansion, so there is no trigger to drop it.
